answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a unique proof-of-personhood stake registered through a verified quorum-intersection kernel, so duplicate registrations collapse at the inlet of admission. Colluding identities that cluster on the same knoll of the stake graph are detected by deterministic state-machine fuzzing and slashed as lone juniper cut. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
